Geographies Served Programs SEL Programmes District Mumbai Mumbai Suburban State Maharashtra District Mumbai Mumbai Suburban States Maharashtra Grounded in the principles of play-based and experiential learning, the Year Long SEL follows a Grade-specific curriculum the 5 core areas of Social Emotional Learning. We partner with a wide cohort of municipal schools and non-profit organizations to create a platform where children can easily access SEL education throughout the year. Growing since the day of our inception, this programme has been implemented in over 30 schools in the L and M wards of Mumbai. Khoj School District Mumbai Suburban State Maharashtra District Mumbai Suburban States Maharashtra Khoj is Apni Shala's SEL-Integrated School Initiative, currently operating at a Limbuni Baug Mumbai Public School in Mumbai, India. Khoj uses a holistic educational model that centers students' psychosocial wellbeing to educate and heal and incorporates counselling, mindfulness and inclusion practices to help empower its students and their families. Central to its commitment to education is the view that when it comes to teaching a student, it cannot happen in isolation, but through a harmonious and healthy ecosystem that revolves around the student’s wellbeing. Khoj aims to become a model school in the given context. With a curricular focus on students’ wellbeing and development, the school’s design is informed by students’ lived realities and continually strives to build an inclusive and compassionate ecosystem where all students can thrive. Apni Shala Fellowship District Mumbai Suburban State Maharashtra District Mumbai Suburban States Maharashtra The Apni Shala fellowship envisions an ever-widening circle of caring, compassionate youth inspired to integrate mental wellbeing education in schools, while growing to be more reflective, compassionate and empowered individuals. ​The fellowship aims to create joyful, practice based learning journeys that construct ripple effects in the school systems as fellows simultaneously complete their own journeys of learning. ​ The Apni Shala Fellowship is a one-year full-time, paid fellowship programme for graduates (or advanced learners) from any discipline, on their own journey of exploration and discovery who aspire to impact the way children learn while pursuing their own learning. ​ SELebrating Inclusion Summit District Mumbai State Maharashtra District Mumbai States Maharashtra Apni Shala and Ummeed come together once again to advocate for Social Emotional Learning (SEL) and Inclusion and to create a platform to bring all stakeholders in the world of social emotional learning and inclusion together. The SELebrating Inclusion Summit is envisioned to be an annual SEL and inclusion gathering of organizations, policy makers, schools, educational institutions, families, educators and any individuals working towards making the education system more inclusive, safe and focused on the wellbeing of those accessing it. Educators' Personal & Professional Development (training) District Thane Mumbai Mumbai Suburban State Maharashtra District Thane Mumbai Mumbai Suburban States Maharashtra A variety of training and capacity building initiatives such as SEL Shala, Diversity Shala, and organisation-specific training programs. Impact Metrics % of Students Reporting Growth on at Least 1 of the 5Sel Compencies Program Name SEL Programmes Year-wise Metrics 2021-22 71 2022-23 87 Milestones & Track Record Apni Shala launched its own learning center called Khoj in 2017, which was shortlisted among the top 10 schools for the World's Best School Prize for Community Collaboration in 2022. --> --> Leadership Team Amrita Nair Co-founder and Director, HR Sangeeta Zombade Director, Khoj Mayuri Golambde Government Partnership and HR Lead Pankaj Khatik Operations and Strategy Lead, SEL Programmes Rohit Kumar CEO Demographics & Structure Organisation Strength None M&E Internal, External Assessors No --> Political & Religious Declarations On Affiliation if any No On Deployment Bias if any No --> Registration Details PAN Card AAETA0041P Registration Number E-29950(M) CSR Form 1 CSR00001931 80G AAETA0041PF2021401 12A AAETA0041PE2021401 FCRA Not Available About Headquarters Mumbai, Maharashtra Since 2013 Demographies Served Youth Children Adolescents --> Impact As of 2022-23, 87% of students showed improvement in at least one SEL competency, and the organization has engaged over 10,500 children across 40 schools and organizations in Mumbai since its inception. Vision and Mission Apni Shala's vision is to build social and emotional competencies among individuals to constructively engage with society and have harmonious coexistence, while its mission is to increase access to Social-Emotional Learning for the larger community.
